description.value:
Your name travels.

When you enter a new location while carrying a Message, the first reaction check made by any NPC in that location toward you is rolled with reroll-lowest. NPCs are predisposed to acknowledge you, even if they do not yet know what you carry.

In any scene where your arrival is expected (the recipient or someone allied with them anticipates you), enemies present must succeed on a Soul defense check vs DC 12 + your Initiation tier × 2 at the start of the scene, or their hostile intent toward you becomes obvious before they can act on it. Their first concealed action against you in the scene is automatically detected by you and your immediate allies.

system.requirements: Route of the Wayfarer Tongue, Shadow Courier Initiation 5
